prerequisites.reason: Difference quotients are limits of functions on punctured neighborhoods; differentiability is compared with continuity and justified using local limit laws.

background: Factoring and expanding polynomials, manipulating fractions with nonzero denominators, and basic function composition. Sine and cosine occur in a later counterexample; their ordinary formulas may be reviewed separately.

description: A derivative is not merely a slope; it is a guarantee that a linear prediction captures the first-order change.
